posts.text: Imagining is fun. But can you point to one? I don’t recall such rhetoric. And if a conservative did say it, that would be dumb and you would criticize it. So what’s your point exactly? “When progressives say indefensible stuff it’s okay because (hypothetical) conservatives say indefensible stuff”?  Maybe you should criticize claims not based on whether people you hate say wrong things, too. Maybe you should just have the courage and seriousness to say something is wrong if it’s wrong.
